title: Billing tokens rejected
summary: billing-api began rejecting valid service tokens after a node image update

logs: billing-api ERROR token used before issued
deployments: node image v9 disabled chronyd at 03:14Z

runbooks.title: Clock skew
runbooks.content: Token timing failures with large clock offset indicate time synchronization loss. Restore a trusted time source and rotate affected nodes.

oracle.root_cause: A node image disabled time synchronization, creating 420-second skew and invalidating billing tokens.
